description: Audit and remediate only an authorized software security boundary while protecting sensitive evidence.
requiredOutcomes: Authorized targets, methods, assets, and trust boundaries are identified.
Findings separate evidence, severity, exploitability, impact, confidence, remediation, and residual risk.
Current advisories use authoritative sources when version or CVE facts are material.
Security-sensitive fixes include focused regression evidence.
forbiddenOutcomes: External systems are scanned or exploited without explicit authorization.
Secrets, personal data, or raw sensitive environment values are persisted.
Unpatched vulnerability details are disclosed publicly.
Static review or a passing scanner is presented as proof that the system is secure.
